final:
-- Names are untrusted. Every file access goes through `fs` narrowed to "notes",
-- so a name can never reach a file outside that directory.

-- True only for a plain file name: non-empty, no path separators, no "..".
safe_name(name: str) -> bool =
  post out == False or name.char_count() > 0
  ex safe_name("a.txt") == True
  ex safe_name("../secret") == False
  if name.char_count() == 0
    return False
  if name == "." or name == ".."
    return False
  if name.split("..").len() > 1
    return False
  for c in name.chars()
    if c == "/" or c == "\\"
      return False
  True

-- True when the name is safe and its file under notes/ can be read.
-- A missing or unreadable file gives False here (it reads as "").
is_readable(name: str) -> bool uses fs =
  pre safe_name(name)
  with fs = fs.sub("notes")
    let text = fs.read(name) else return False
    True

-- Number of names in `names` that are readable files under notes/.
count_readable(names: List[str]) -> int uses fs =
  post out >= 0
  post out <= names.len()
  var n = 0
  for name in names
    if safe_name(name)
      if is_readable(name)
        n += 1
  n
